skills.name: render-link-builder
skills.description: Produce a self-contained, lightly minified HTML animation for ClipACanvas and build its direct render link (URL-encoded code, 1920x1080 horizontal by default). Use whenever the user wants an HTML/Canvas/SVG motion graphic that renders through the ClipACanvas render endpoint.

skills.name: fmea-rpn-prioritizer
skills.description: Prioritize failure modes from a FMEA worksheet (CSV with severity, occurrence, detection 1-10) by Risk Priority Number and flag high-severity items for review. Use for preventive maintenance, industrial utility reliability reviews, root cause analysis, and DMAIC improvement planning.

skills.name: short-circuit-calculator
skills.description: Estimate symmetrical three-phase short-circuit current (Ik and peak ip) at a bus from utility short-circuit MVA and transformer impedance percent, using IEC 60909-style simplified formulas. Use for electrical power system pre-checks and student/engineering analysis of fault levels.

skills.name: skill-engineering-standard
skills.description: Author, review, and validate ZY Skill Library skills against the 13-section engineering standard (triggers, scope, workflow, decision rules, error handling, QC, acceptance criteria, tests, sources, license). Use when creating a new skill, editing an existing SKILL.md, or checking that the library passes validation before a commit.

skills.name: third-party-skill-audit
skills.description: Statically scan a third-party skill, script, or plugin folder for high-risk patterns (remote pipe-to-shell, encoded exec, credential path access, shell profile edits, unpinned installs, binaries, symlinks) before anyone runs or installs it. Use whenever the user wants to adopt a skill or script from an external GitHub repository.

skills.name: srs-sm2-scheduler
skills.description: Schedule spaced-repetition reviews for Japanese vocabulary, kanji, and grammar cards using the SM-2 algorithm (quality 0-5, ease factor, interval days). Use when building or testing review logic for JLPT N5-N1 study tools such as AmiraVerse, or when computing next due dates for flashcards.

skills.name: position-size-calculator
skills.description: Calculate position size from account equity, fixed-fraction risk percent, entry and stop-loss prices, and contract value per unit (e.g. XAUUSD lot specs). Use for risk management planning before a trade. Provides sizing math only, never trade signals or profit guarantees.

skills.name: trade-statistics
skills.description: Compute backtest or journal performance statistics from a list of per-trade PnL values - win rate, expectancy, profit factor, and maximum drawdown with sample-size warnings. Use for evaluating a trading strategy's historical results, including XAUUSD ICT/SMC backtests. Never promises future profit.

skills.name: secret-leak-scan
skills.description: Scan a project for accidentally committed secrets (Google API keys, AWS access keys, private keys, GitHub/Stripe/OpenAI-style tokens, generic password or token assignments) and report masked previews only. Use before committing or pushing code, especially Flutter/Supabase or AI-API projects.
